trust_decision.summary: Which plant column names an API caller may splice into the SELECT list; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: the include_info query value goes unchecked into the PlantsModel::getSpecificInfo raw SELECT. The fix checks each comma-separated item against PlantsModel::$allowed_attributes.

landing_point.why: The summary names /api/locations/list and include_info; the handler reads it at api.php:642 and passes it to getSpecificInfo at api.php:650, which is the only call site.

fix_sites.module_kind: model (data access), same model as the existing validateAttribute helper

fix_sites.entry_point: same route; allow-list extended with 'id' and 'created_at' (fix.diff:52, fix.diff:61-62) so the default include_info='id' keeps working
same route; new validateAttrList helper added next to validateAttribute (fix.diff:75-85)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no second route into getSpecificInfo; the only plausible dismissal concerns the admin toggle's column-name concatenation (app/models/AppModel.php:39), which uses another table and model and needs an admin session, so it is outside this advisory's sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: include_info must keep accepting a single column and a comma-separated column list (e.g. 'id,name'), and the default 'id'. A fix that only allows identifier characters, or that adds 'id' to the allow-list without splitting the list, breaks multi-column requests; a strict allow-list that leaves out 'id' breaks the default.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: app/controller/api.php:642 (default 'id'); app/models/PlantsModel.php:38-58 (allow-list lacks 'id' at the pinned commit); fix.diff:94-98

O6_input_shapes: comma-separated column list, each item trimmed (fix.diff:78-80)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getAll and getHistory (PlantsModel.php:155, :256) already come as a pair with the same sorting checks; a history twin of getSpecificInfo would follow the same pattern.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function already concatenates a LIMIT fragment, and the same route (/api/locations/list) feeds it.

O10_build.project_tests: Only app/tests/bootstrap.php was found; no tests for the locations API or PlantsModel were seen in this screen.
